about_the_game:
Every dawn, the kingdom rises and every dusk, it falls again. In Kingspath, you take the role of a weary king trying to rebuild his realm from the ashes. Each day brings new chances to grow stronger, but also new battles to survive.

CITY BY DAY, BATTLE BY DUSK
Build and expand your city, unlock new units, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for the chaos to come. When night falls, lead your army into the battlefield command your troops with simple but crucial orders like “Charge!”, “Fall back!”, or “Hold the line!” You control only your king. The rest of the army fights automatically, following your lead. Each decision shapes your legacy.

ROGUELIKE STRATEGY LOOP
Kingspath combines base-building strategy with roguelike progression. Each campaign is unique: lose your battles, and you start again  wiser, stronger, and slightly more suspicious of your archers.

⚙️ EARLY DEVELOPMENT ⚙️
Kingspath is currently in early development by a small indie team who love medieval chaos, and tactical disasters. Follow the journey, join the feedback, and help us shape the path of the kings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7 (32/64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Pentium(R) 1.10 GHz
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce 8800 or ATI Radeon® X1900
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space

short_description: Lead your king. Command your army. Rebuild your realm. Kingspath is a 2D pixel-art strategy roguelike where you control your king on the battlefield, give real-time commands, and fight to restore a fallen kingdom one day at a time.
